gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diffuse Midline Glioma, H3 K27M-Mutant; Recurrent High Grade Glioma
Histologically confirmed newly diagnosed DIPG/DMG with documented H3K27M alteration (based on IHC or DNA sequencing performed in a CLIA-certified laboratory) or recurrent HGG.

candidate_evidence.quote: CD200AR-L is a newly developed agent that binds to CD200-AR.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Study treatment will begin approximately 14 days after the completion of standard of care radiation therapy for patients with newly diagnosed DMG/DIPG and at the time of recurrence for patients with HGG.

role_evidence.quote: in combination with imiquimod and GBM6-AD vaccine to treat malignant glioma in children and young adults

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational CD200 activation receptor ligand (immune adjuvant)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: binds to the CD200 activation receptor on immune cells, activating immune cells and overcoming CD200-mediated inhibition

role_evidence.quote: Each patient will also be given topical imiquimod and a single dose of 300cGy re-irradiation.

agents.drug_class_hint: topical TLR7 agonist used as vaccine adjuvant

flag.reason: Imiquimod is a vaccine adjuvant in the experimental regimen with no separate antitumour hypothesis; could be viewed as supportive rather than a second investigational agent.

role_evidence.quote: On the second day, following application of Imiquimod cream and CD200AR-L injection, 2 supraclavicular injections of GBM6-AD vaccine will be given.

source_quote.quote: Histologically confirmed newly diagnosed DIPG/DMG with documented H3K27M alteration

coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult (ages 2-25; stdAges CHILD and ADULT) phase 1; glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm label (the vaccine name GBM6-AD is not a population statement), so S5 is high_grade_glioma_unspecified. The single registered intervention bundles CD200AR-L, imiquimod, GBM6-AD vaccine and a single 300 cGy radiation dose; agents split by the text. H3K27M required for the newly diagnosed DMG/DIPG stratum only, not for recurrent HGG.
